basic-housekeeping-header.name: Basic Housekeeping (or, I Won't Make a Tutorial on Using MLR)
basic-housekeeping-header.description: Where Menu Loop Randomizer's housekeeping options are.

tutorial.description: The closest thing to a tutorial on using MLR is this video by Colours Gaming: <cl>https://youtu.be/J2_UwVsgjHs&t=60s</c>. <c_>It's far from the intended way to use MLR, but nice to have.</c>

song-fetching-storing-header.name: Song Fetching/Storing
song-fetching-storing-header.description: Choose where Menu Loop Randomizer fetches/stores its songs.

useCustomSongs.name: Use Custom Songs Instead
useCustomSongs.description:
Use your own songs instead of songs you have downloaded from Newgrounds or RobTop's Music Library.

<cy>Find instructions in the mod info popup.</c>

loadPlaylistFile.name: Load Playlist File Instead
loadPlaylistFile.description:
<cl>Based on an original idea by TheTrueNyxa.</c>

Choose a `.txt` file containing a list of song file paths that MLR will load as menu loop options.

Note that your `blacklist.txt` and `favorites.txt` files will still apply.

## ***<c-ff0000>MLR PLAYLIST FILES ARE __FOR PERSONAL USE ONLY__. MLR PLAYLIST FILES SHOULD __NOT__ BE SHARED BETWEEN DEVICES OR USERS.</c>***

playlistFile.name: Playlist File (.txt Files ONLY)
playlistFile.description:
<cl>Based on an original idea by TheTrueNyxa.</c>

Choose a `.txt` file containing a list of song file paths that MLR will either:
- load as menu loop options, if <cl>"Load Playlist File Instead"</c> is enabled.
- edit to add new songs to the selected playlist file, if <cl>"Load Playlist File Instead"</c> is disabled.

## ***<c-ff0000>MLR PLAYLIST FILES ARE __FOR PERSONAL USE ONLY__. MLR PLAYLIST FILES SHOULD __NOT__ BE SHARED BETWEEN DEVICES OR USERS.</c>***

song-selection-modes-header.name: Song Selection
song-selection-modes-header.description: Choose how Menu Loop Randomizer finds songs to pick from.

playlistMode.name: Constant Shuffle Mode
playlistMode.description:
<cl>Original idea by TheKevinner.</c> <cp>Formerly known as "Playlist Mode".</c>

Change menu loops after a song is finished. Requires more than 1 song available to work.

<c-ff0000>This feature is ***__VERY__*** unstable. It's best if you restart your game after toggling this setting.</c>

<cy>Known potential issues:</c>
<cy>- Constant Shuffle Mode may break when there is only one song for MLR to choose from.
<cy>- Constant Shuffle Mode may not be accurate with choosing a cutoff point to change songs.

saveSongOnGameClose.name: Remember Last Menu Loop
saveSongOnGameClose.description:
<cl>Original idea by HexCodesGMD.</c>

If enabled, this mod's most recently chosen menu loop will be the first loop you hear the next time you open Geometry Dash.

button-management-header.name: Button Management
button-management-header.description: Choose how (many) buttons from Menu Loop Randomizer are displayed.

buttonMode.name: Button Mode
buttonMode.description:
<cl>Original idea by dasshuDEV and Hanifinio.</c>

Minimal: Only the "Control Panel" button is added.

Reduced: The <cl>Blacklist Song</c>, <cl>Favorite Song</c>, <cl>Hold Song</c>, <cl>Previous Song</c>, <cl>Add to Playlist</c>, and <cl>View Song List</c> buttons stay inside the MLR "Control Panel" to reduce clutter on MenuLayer.

Classic: Places the <cl>Blacklist Song</c>, <cl>Favorite Song</c>, <cl>Hold Song</c>, <cl>Previous Song</c>, <cl>Add to Playlist</c>, and <cl>View Song List</c> buttons to the right side of MenuLayer (or the bottom of MenuLayer, if you use Overcharged Main Menu).

No Buttons: No buttons are added. <co>***__IF ECLIPSE MENU INTEGRATION IS NOT ACTIVE WHILE THIS OPTION IS SELECTED, MLR WILL FALL BACK ONTO THE  `Minimal`  SETTING.__***</c>

enableCopySongID.name: "Copy Song ID" Button
enableCopySongID.description:
<cl>Original idea by Akashnil. Original sprite by hiimjustin000.</c>

Enables the <cj>copy Song ID</c> in the main menu.

<cy>If</c> <cl>"Use Custom Songs Instead"</c> <cy>is enabled, this button will copy the song name instead.</c>

enableShuffleButton.name: Shuffle Button
enableShuffleButton.description:
Enables the <cj>shuffle button</c> in the main menu.

<cy>Using this button is not the same feature as enabling</c> <cl>"Constant Shuffle Mode"</c><cy>, although it *can* work with</c> <cl>"Constant Shuffle Mode"</c> <cy>enabled. This button only changes the menu loop to a different song *when pressed*, instead of when a song finishes.</c>

enableBlacklistButton.name: Blacklist Button
enableBlacklistButton.description:
<cl>Original idea by AlphaQuata.</c>

Enables the <cj>blacklist button</c> in the main menu.

<cy>Using this button prevents a song from being chosen as a menu loop, and chooses a new menu loop song.</c>

<cy>Only applicable when using the "Classic" Button Mode.</c>

enableFavoriteButton.name: Favorite Button
enableFavoriteButton.description:
<cl>Original idea by AlphaQuata.</c>

Enables the <cj>favorite button</c> in the main menu.

<cy>Using this button increases the chance a song will be chosen as a menu loop.</c>

<cy>Only applicable when using the "Classic" Button Mode.</c>

enableHoldSongButton.name: Hold Song Button (READ!)
enableHoldSongButton.description:
Enables the <cj>"Hold Song" button</c> in the main menu.

<cy>Like Tetris, using this button holds onto the name of the current song, and swaps menu loop songs with a previously held song (if there is one).</c>

<cy>Only applicable when using the "Classic" Button Mode.</c>

enablePreviousButton.name: Previous Song Button (READ!)
enablePreviousButton.description:
<cl>Original idea by DurexSensitive.</c>

Go back <c-ff0000>one</c> song. This does <c-ff0000>NOT</c> store your entire menu loop history, only one song at a time.

Don't expect this intentional limitation to go away anytime soon.

<cy>Only applicable when using the "Classic" Button Mode.</c>

enableAddToPlaylistButton.name: Add To Playlist Button (READ!)
enableAddToPlaylistButton.description:
<cl>Based on an original idea by TheTrueNyxa.</c>

Adds the currently playing song to the selected <cl>Playlist File</c> (see other mod settings).

<cy>Only applicable when using the "Classic" Button Mode.</c>

enableViewSongListButton.name: View Song List Button (READ!)
enableViewSongListButton.description:
<cl>Based on an original idea by TheTrueNyxa.</c>

Lets you view the names of the menu loops MLR has loaded.

<cy>Only applicable when using the "Classic" Button Mode.</c>

enableNewNotification.name: New Notif Button
enableNewNotification.description: Enables the <cj>notification regeneration button</c> in the main menu.

notifications-header.name: Notifications
notifications-header.description: Settings for "Now Playing" notifications in Menu Loop Randomizer.

enableNotification.name: "Now Playing" Notifs
enableNotification.description: Shows a notification with the name of the currently playing song.

songFormatNGML.name: Newgrounds/Music Library Song Name Format
songFormatNGML.description:
Choose the format you prefer for "Now Playing" notifications (and as a fallback option for other menus from MLR).

<cy>Only applies to Newgrounds/Music Library songs.</c>

removeSuffix.name: Hide File Extension
removeSuffix.description:
Hides the file extension of the song being played, <co>if it's still included somehow</c>.
<cy>Only applies when using custom songs as the menu loop.</c>

showOutsideOfMainMenu.name: Show Outside of Main Menu
showOutsideOfMainMenu.description: If this setting is disabled, most notifications will not show outside of GD's main menu.

customPrefix.name: Prefix
customPrefix.description:
Set your prefix for the "Now Playing" notification here.

<cy>To disable the prefix, set it to </c><cl>"[Empty]"</c><cy>.</c>

notificationTime.name: Duration
notificationTime.description: Adjust the time that the notification is on screen.

notificationFont.name: Font
notificationFont.description:
Choose the font the notification will use. Default is 17 for legacy purposes.

<cj>0 for Pusab, -1 for Golden Pusab, and -2 for the font you see when viewing level comments.</c>
<cy>To use font numbers greater than 0: refer to the level editor for the font each number corresponds to, subtract that number by 1, and then put it here.</c>

song-randomization-header.name: Song Randomization
song-randomization-header.description: Choose how Menu Loop Randomizer selects a random song.

randomizeWhenExitingLevel.name: Randomize Menu Loop on Level Exit
randomizeWhenExitingLevel.description:
Randomize the song when you exit a level.

<cy>This setting takes higher priority over the "Continue Menu Loop on Level Exit" setting. If this setting is enabled, menu loops will NOT continue from where you left off when leaving a level, even if you enabled the other setting.</c>

randomizeWhenExitingEditor.name: Randomize Menu Loop on Editor Exit
randomizeWhenExitingEditor.description:
Randomize the song when you exit the editor.

<cy>This setting takes higher priority over the "Continue Menu Loop on Editor Exit" setting. If this setting is enabled, menu loops will NOT continue from where you left off when leaving the editor, even if you enabled the other setting.</c>

restoreWhenExitingLevel.name: Continue Menu Loop on Level Exit
restoreWhenExitingLevel.description:
<cp>***__THIS SETTING IS IGNORED IF COLON'S "MENU LOOP START TIME" MOD IS LOADED AND ENABLED.__***</c>
<c-aaaaaa>Naggingly suggested by Myron472/GlydeR and Abagur900.</c>

Continue the song from where you left off when you exit a level.

<cy>This setting is ignored when "Randomize Menu Loop on Level Exit" is enabled. If that other setting is enabled, menu loops will ALWAYS be randomized when leaving a level.</c>

<c-ff0000>This does ***__NOT__*** continue menu loops from where you started off between game restarts.</c>

restoreWhenExitingEditor.name: Continue Menu Loop on Editor Exit
restoreWhenExitingEditor.description:
<cp>***__THIS SETTING IS IGNORED IF COLON'S "MENU LOOP START TIME" MOD IS LOADED AND ENABLED.__***</c>
<c-aaaaaa>Naggingly suggested by Myron472/GlydeR and Abagur900.</c>

Continue the song from where you left off when you exit the editor.

<cy>This setting is ignored when "Randomize Menu Loop on Editor Exit" is enabled. If that other setting is enabled, menu loops will ALWAYS be randomized when leaving the editor.</c>

<c-ff0000>This does ***__NOT__*** continue menu loops from where you started off between game restarts.</c>

misc-playback-header.name: Misc. Playback Settings
misc-playback-header.description: Settings for Menu Loop Randomizer's playback options that didn't belong elsewhere.

restoreWhenInterrupted.name: Continue Menu Loop After Interruption
restoreWhenInterrupted.description:
<cp>***__THIS SETTING IS IGNORED IF COLON'S "MENU LOOP START TIME" MOD IS LOADED AND ENABLED.__***</c>
<c-cccccc>Based on previous mod features naggingly suggested by Myron472/GlydeR and Abagur900.</c>

Continue the song from where you left off when the menu loop is restored. Useful for when visiting other menus with custom menu loops.

<cy>Please see the "Continue Menu Loop on Level Exit" and "Continue Menu Loop on Editor Exit" settings as well, as this setting is not designed for those usecases.</c>

fadeInTime.name: Menu Loop Fade In Duration (In Seconds)
fadeInTime.description: Adjust the fade in duration of the menu loop (in seconds). To "disable" this setting, use the default value of 1.0.

song-list-header.name: Song List Settings
song-list-header.description: Settings for the Song List menu from Menu Loop Randomizer.

showScrollingShortcuts.name: Show Scrolling Shortcuts
showScrollingShortcuts.description: Choose if you want scrolling shortcuts in the Song List menu.

autoScrollToCurrentSong.name: Auto-Scroll to Current Song
autoScrollToCurrentSong.description: Choose if you want to automatically scroll to the current song when opening the Song List menu.

alwaysAutoScrollToCurrentSong.name: Always Auto-Scroll to Current Song
alwaysAutoScrollToCurrentSong.description: Choose if you always want to automatically scroll to the current song when doing anything in the Song List menu ***__AND__*** when changing songs.

showSearchBar.name: Show Search Bar
showSearchBar.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, NO SEARCH BAR WILL APPEAR.__***</c>

Choose if you want to show the search bar in the Song List menu.

showFilterOrSearchResultsCount.name: Show Filter/Search Result Count
showFilterOrSearchResultsCount.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, THIS SETTING WILL BE IGNORED.__***</c>

Choose if you want to show the number of search results when filtering or searching for songs in the Song List menu.

compactModeScaleFactor.name: Compact Mode Scale Factor
compactModeScaleFactor.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, COMPACT MODE CANNOT BE ENABLED.__***</c>

Choose how much smaller each song entry in the Song List becomes when enabling Compact Mode. The higher this number, the smaller each song entry in the Song List becomes.

showSortSongOptions.name: Show Sorting Options
showSortSongOptions.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, NO SONG SORTING OPTIONS WILL APPEAR.__***</c>

Choose if you want to show song sorting options in the Song List menu.

showSortSongLength.name: Show Song Length Sorting Option (READ!)
showSortSongLength.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, NO SONG SORTING OPTIONS WILL APPEAR.__***</c>

Choose if you want the option to sort songs by their length in the Song List menu.

<cy>Requires "Show Sorting Options" to be enabled.</c>

showExtraInfoLabel.name: Show Extra Song Info in Compact Mode
showExtraInfoLabel.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, NO EXTRA LABELS WILL APPEAR.__***</c>

Choose if you want to show extra information about a specific song when Compact Mode is enabled in the Song List menu.

showPlaybackProgressControlsSongList.name: Show Playback Progress and Controls
showPlaybackProgressControlsSongList.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, NO CONTROLS WILL APPEAR.__***</c>

Choose if you want to show playback controls for the currently playing song in the Song List menu.

songScrubbingInSongList.name: Song Scrubbing in Song List
songScrubbingInSongList.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, THIS SETTING WILL BE IGNORED.__***</c>

Choose if you want to scrub along the golden popup title of the Song List menu to change song playback position of the currently playing song.

songScrubbingSpeedFactorInSongList.name: iOS-like Controls For Fine-grained Song Scrubbing in Song List
songScrubbingSpeedFactorInSongList.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, THIS SETTING WILL BE IGNORED.__***</c>

Choose if you want to allow classic iOS-like controls for fine-grained song scrubbing. This would trigger along the area BELOW the golden popup title of the Song List menu.

youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsSongList.name: YT/VLC/Spotify-like Hotkeys
youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsSongList.description:
Choose if you want to use <cr>YT</c>/<c-FFA544>VLC</c>/<c-06CE91>Spotify</c>-like shortcuts to control playback progress or control song selection in the Song List menu.

- <cr>Numrow/Numpad 0-9</c>: Control playback progress position. (0 = 0%, 1 = 10%, etc..., 9 = 90%.)
- <cr>Shift + N</c>, <c-06CE91>Ctrl + S</c>, <c-FFA544>Command + Right Arrow</c> (macOS)/<c-FFA544>Ctrl + Right Arrow</c> (Windows): Shuffle song
- <cr>Shift + P</c>, <c-FFA544>Command + Left Arrow</c> (macOS)/<c-FFA544>Ctrl + Left Arrow</c> (Windows): Play previous song (if available)
- <c-06CE91>Command + R</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Ctrl + R</c> (Windows): Restart current song
- <c-06CE91>Cmd + H</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Ctrl + H</c>, <c-06CE91>Cmd + K</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Ctrl + K</c> (Windows): Switch to Control Panel
- <c-06CE91>Shift + Ctrl + B</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Shift + Alt + B</c> (Windows): Favorite current song
- <c-06CE91>Shift + Cmd + J</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Shift + Ctrl + J</c> (Windows): Scroll to current song

youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsSongListNo.name: Don't Use Numrow for Hotkeys
youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsSongListNo.description: Ignore numrow presses for YT/VLC/Spotify-like hotkeys in the Song List menu.

youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsSongListNo.name: Don't Use Numpad for Hotkeys
youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsSongListNo.description: Ignore numpad presses for YT/VLC/Spotify-like hotkeys in the Song List menu.

control-panel-header.name: Control Panel Settings
control-panel-header.description: Settings for the Control Panel from Menu Loop Randomizer.

songIndicatorsInControlPanel.name: Song Indicators
songIndicatorsInControlPanel.description:
Apply the song indicators seen in the Song List menu into the Control Panel's song name text.

As a reminder, the song indicators are:
- Gold = <cy>favorited</c>.
- Green = <cg>current</c>.
- Italics = NG/ML song stored in an unexpected place.
- Dark gradients OR random letters/numbers = Jukebox/NONG, <c-ff0000>OR</c> someone else goofed up.

<c-aaaaaa>For a number of reasons, the dark gradient and the green song name do not appear in the Control Panel.</c>

showPlaybackProgressAndControls.name: Show Playback Progress and Controls
showPlaybackProgressAndControls.description: Choose if you want to show playback controls and playback progress about the currently playing song in the Control Panel menu.

songScrubbingInControlPanel.name: Song Scrubbing in Control Panel
songScrubbingInControlPanel.description: Choose if you want to scrub along the dark progress bar of the Control Panel menu to change song playback position of the currently playing song.

songScrubbingSpeedFactorInControlPanel.name: iOS-like Controls For Fine-grained Song Scrubbing in Control Panel
songScrubbingSpeedFactorInControlPanel.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, THIS SETTING WILL BE IGNORED.__***</c>

Choose if you want to allow classic iOS-like controls for fine-grained song scrubbing. This would trigger along the area ABOVE the playback progress bar of the Control Panel.

youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsControlPan.name: YT/VLC/Spotify-like Hotkeys
youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsControlPan.description:
Choose if you want to use <cr>YT</c>/<c-FFA544>VLC</c>/<c-06CE91>Spotify</c>-like shortcuts to control playback progress or control song selection in the Control Panel menu.

- <cr>Numrow/Numpad 0-9</c>: Control playback progress position. (0 = 0%, 1 = 10%, etc..., 9 = 90%.)
- <cr>Shift + N</c>, <c-06CE91>Ctrl + S</c>, <c-FFA544>Command + Right Arrow</c> (macOS)/<c-FFA544>Ctrl + Right Arrow</c> (Windows): Shuffle song
- <cr>Shift + P</c>, <c-FFA544>Command + Left Arrow</c> (macOS)/<c-FFA544>Ctrl + Left Arrow</c> (Windows): Play previous song (if available)
- <c-06CE91>Command + R</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Ctrl + R</c> (Windows): Restart current song
- <c-06CE91>Cmd + K</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Ctrl + K</c> (Windows): Switch to Song List
- <c-06CE91>Shift + Ctrl + B</c> (macOS)/<c-06CE91>Shift + Alt + B</c> (Windows): Favorite current song

youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsControlPan.name: Don't Use Numrow for Hotkeys
youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsControlPan.description: Ignore numrow presses for YT/VLC/Spotify-like hotkeys in the Control Panel menu.

youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsControlPan.name: Don't Use Numpad for Hotkeys
youtubeAndVLCKeyboardShortcutsControlPan.description: Ignore numpad presses for YT/VLC/Spotify-like hotkeys in the Control Panel menu.

osuLazerBootleg.name: "welcome to osu!" bootleg
osuLazerBootleg.description:
<c-ff66aa>welcome to osu!</c>

Press  `O`  or  `Enter`  to make the Control Panel the only visible UI element on-screen, much like the <c-ff66aa>osu!</c> cookie logo seen in <c-ff66aa>osu!lazer</c>.

autoOsuLazerBootleg.name: Automatically toggle "welcome to osu!" on Control Panel open
autoOsuLazerBootleg.description: Automatically make the Control Panel the only visible UI element on-screen, much like the <c-ff66aa>osu!</c> cookie logo seen in <c-ff66aa>osu!lazer</c>.

misc-header.name: Miscellaneous Settings
misc-header.description: Other settings for Menu Loop Randomizer that needed a category.

eclipseIntegration.name: Eclipse Menu Integration
eclipseIntegration.description:
<cp>RESTART REQUIRED FOR CHANGES TO APPLY.</c>

View song playback progress and control the selected song from Eclipse Menu!

<cl>Eclipse Menu</c> is <co>REQUIRED</c> for this option to work.

qolModIntegration.name: QOLMod Integration
qolModIntegration.description:
<cp>RESTART REQUIRED FOR CHANGES TO APPLY.</c>

View song playback progress and control the selected song from QOLMod!

<cl>QOLMod</c> is <co>REQUIRED</c> for this option to work.

qolModIntegrationSongList.name: QOLMod Integration: Include Song List
qolModIntegrationSongList.description:
<cp>MAY BRIEFLY FREEZE DEVICES LOADING THOUSANDS OF SONGS FOR MENU LOOP RANDOMIZER.</c>

Open the Song List menu from QOLMod!

<cl>QOLMod</c> is <co>REQUIRED</c> for this option to work.

copySongDisplayName.name: Copy All Song Info, Not Just Song ID (READ!)
copySongDisplayName.description:
<cl>Continuing from an original idea by Akashnil.</c>

When copying information about the current song and it's from Newgrounds or the Music Library, copy the song's full display name (title, artist name, song ID) instead of just the song ID.

useMiniaudioForLength.name: Use Miniaudio to Find Song Length
useMiniaudioForLength.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, THIS OPTION DOES NOTHING.__***</c>

Choose if you prefer Miniaudio over FMOD for finding the length of a song. If this option is disabled, FMOD will find the lengths of all of your songs instead. This means song length calculations are more precise, but take slightly longer to complete.

<c-aaaaaa>*(Note that in some cases, FMOD may still be used to find the length of a song if Miniaudio fails to do so.)*</c>

incrementDecrementByMilliseconds.name: Playback Progress Controls Forward/Backward Amount (MS)
incrementDecrementByMilliseconds.description:
<c-ff0000>***__IF THE "BETTER TOUCH PRIO" MOD BY UNDEFINED0 + ALK1M123 IS NOT INSTALLED, THIS SETTING IS IGNORED.__***</c>

Choose how many milliseconds to go forward/backward in when using the playback progress controls in both the Control Panel and the Song List menus.

<cy>If</c> <cl>Constant Shuffle Mode</c> <c-aaaaaa>(formerly known as Playlist Mode)</c> <cy>is enabled, going past the end of the current song will shuffle a new song, and going backwards will be capped to the very start of the song.</c>

Otherwise, going too far past the end or the beginning of the current song will wrap around from the opposite end of the song.

specificSongOverride.name: Specific Menu Loop File Override
specificSongOverride.description:
In case you *hate* the randomizer elements from this mod.

<cy>Leave this as blank to disable this option.</c>

advanced-header.name: Advanced Settings
advanced-header.description: Advanced settings for Menu Loop Randomizer.

dangerousBlacklisting.name: (DANGEROUS) Dangerous Blacklisting
dangerousBlacklisting.description:
<cl>Original idea by Aktimoose.</c>

Attempts to remove the lagspike when removing songs.

<c-ff0000>This is an experimental setting. You agree to hold yourself responsible for any issues/lag/damages/crashes that happen when this setting is enabled.</c>

additionalFolder.name: (DANGEROUS) Additional Custom Songs Folder
additionalFolder.description:
<cl>Original idea by RighteousRyan.</c>

Add an additional song folder for custom songs.

<c-ff0000>This is an EXPERIMENTAL setting. By enabling this, you will hold yourself responsible for any issues/lag/damages/crashes that happen with this setting enabled. You also agree that this setting was added despite the developer's (RayDeeUx's) lack of personal belief/confidence that this feature belongs in MLR.</c>

searchDeeper.name: (DANGEROUS) Check Within Subdirectories
searchDeeper.description:
<cl>Original idea by RighteousRyan.</c>

Search for songs within subdirectories.

<c-ff0000>This is an EXPERIMENTAL setting. By enabling this, you will hold yourself responsible for any issues/lag/damages/crashes that happen with this setting enabled. You also agree that this setting was added despite the developer's (RayDeeUx's) lack of personal belief/confidence that this feature belongs in MLR.</c>

melowodyMode.name: (DANGEROUS) Alternate String to Path Conversion
melowodyMode.description:
<cl>Contributed by</c> <c-797979>mel</c><c-ffc272>owo</c><c-414141>dy</c><cl>.</c>

<cp>FOR WINDOWS DEVICES ONLY.</c>

Use a different method of converting raw strings to filesystem paths.

<c-ff0000>This is an EXPERIMENTAL setting. By enabling this, you will hold yourself responsible for any issues/lag/damages/crashes that happen with this setting enabled. You also agree that this setting was added despite general lack of personal belief/confidence that this feature belongs in MLR from various members of Geode Team.</c>

liveDownloadedSongUpdating.name: (DANGEROUS) Live Updating of Downloaded Songs
liveDownloadedSongUpdating.description:
<cl>Original idea by cypher798.</c>

Add a song to the songs pool when successfully downloading it without having to reload the remainder of the existing song pool.

<cp>*This option applies when* ***__BOTH__***</c> <cl>*"Use Custom Songs Instead"*</c> <cp>***__AND__***</c> <cl>*"Load Playlist File Instead"*</c> <cp>*are disabled* ***__ONLY__*** *.*</c>

<c-ff0000>This is an EXPERIMENTAL setting. By enabling this, you will hold yourself responsible for any issues/lag/damages/crashes that happen with this setting enabled. You also agree that this setting was added despite general lack of personal belief/confidence that this feature belongs in MLR from various members of Geode Team.</c>

useHashesForMatching.name: Use Hashes To Find Current Song
useHashesForMatching.description:
<cp>FOR WINDOWS DEVICES ONLY.</c>

Check if a song is the current song via hashed strings instead of pure string matching.

<c-ff0000>If none of that made sense to you, don't edit this setting.</c>
